func get(t *testing.T, handler http.Handler, path string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	t.Helper()
	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
	handler.ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
	return recorder
}

declaration_hash_rule: Raw func through column-zero closing brace; exclude following LF. Explicit manually reviewed bounds only. All quoted spans similarly exclude final LF.

classification_definitions.integration: Asserted behavior materially crosses actual project service/API/network/process/store/runtime boundary. Controlled provider data may surround genuine protocol traffic.
classification_definitions.unit: Synthetic/local validation, transformation, recorder calls, clocks or compression without actual qualifying boundary. Incidental setup does not qualify.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct independent local-only assertion blocks combined with genuine boundary assertion blocks.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Source or mapping insufficient; separate from runtime UNKNOWN.

fixture_limits: fixturePage starts httptest.NewServer and performs server.Client().Get over loopback HTTP, reading the response body. Dashboard.Handler has no authentication; production private listener/session protection is not exercised.

get and getGzipped only use ResponseRecorder/NewRequest and direct ServeHTTP. Dispatcher confirmed the established rule: synthetic/local state alone makes these unit. Roots1266/1269/1270 use only those/direct-load paths.
